projects.name: Wunder Fund Alfa Connectome: HFT Order-Book Prediction
projects.subtitle: Team Varanasi
bullets: Ongoing: public rank 302 of 5,111.

Built a stateful GRU that predicts two future-price indicators row by row from a live stream of 112 limit-order-book features on two instruments; 0.687 weighted Pearson on validation against the official baseline's 0.617.

Met a 1-vCPU, ~90-microsecond-per-row latency budget for 39.4M test rows: int8-quantised ONNX export (score loss under 0.0001) cut inference from 203 to 59 microseconds per row, so a two-model ensemble runs in about 34 of the 60 minutes allowed. Treated every change as a controlled experiment: a baseline calibration submission showed the validation-to-leaderboard drop was shared by everyone, and seed noise (0.0013) was measured before any gain was accepted. Climbed from rank 543 to 302 with 6 submissions.
